# 1 Enoch Chapter 8 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**8:1** And-Azazel taught men to-make swords, and-knives, and-shields, and-breastplates, and-made-known to-them the-metals [of-the-earth] and-the-art of-working-them, and-bracelets, and-ornaments, and-the-use of-antimony, and-the-beautifying of-the-eyelids, and-all kinds of-costly stones, and-all colouring-tinctures.

**8:2** And-there-arose much godlessness, and-they committed-fornication, and-they were-led-astray, and-became-corrupt in-all their-ways. Shemihazah taught enchantments, and-root-cuttings, Armaros the-resolving of-enchantments, Baraqel [taught] astrology, Kokabel the-constellations, Ezeqel the-knowledge of-the-clouds,

**8:3** Araqiel the-signs of-the-earth, Shamsiel the-signs of-the-sun, and-Sariel the-course of-the-moon. And-as-men perished, they-cried, and-their-cry went-up to-heaven.

**8:4** And-then Michael and-Uriel and-Raphael and-Gabriel looked-down from-the-sanctuary of-heaven and-saw the-much-blood that-was-being-shed on-the-earth, and-all the-lawlessness that-was-being-done on-the-earth.

---

*EMET notes: Chapter 8 catalogs the two categories of angelic corruption: (1) Azazel's instruction in metallurgy, weaponry, and cosmetics (v. 1); (2) the other Watchers teaching forbidden knowledge — enchantments, astrology, cosmological signs (vv. 2–3). The list of Watcher-teachers and their domains is a key passage for understanding the text's demonology. The verse enumeration follows Charles/Knibb. Verse 4 may belong to the ch. 9 complex in some manuscripts.*
